note: Every number here is a synthetic placeholder chosen for plausibility, not fitted to real F1 data. Calibrate later; code reads only this file.

reliability.formula: p_dnf = base + sum_c r_c * power_unit_stress * max(0, wear_c - onset)^2, capped

overtaking.formula: a following car completes a pass in a segment only if it would finish the segment at least pass_base + overtaking_difficulty * pass_scale seconds ahead; otherwise it is held min_gap behind
overtaking.dirty_air: configured races replace the legacy positional traffic term with a dirty-air loss for any car starting a segment within dirty_air_gap_sec of the car ahead

team_archetype_pace_offset_sec_per_lap.note: Published performance profile. Each team's offsets average to zero across the five archetypes, so no team gains on average.

rival_component_policy.rule: before each race, replace any component with wear >= threshold (or above max_wear_for_use), using free units while they last
